mapper.select: SELECT id, student_no, name, gender, birth_date, class_name, phone, email, created_at, updated_at FROM students WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, student_no, name, gender, birth_date, class_name, phone, email, created_at, updated_at FROM students ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO students (student_no, name, gender, birth_date, class_name, phone, email) VALUES (#{studentNo}, #{name}, #{gender}, #{birthDate}, #{className}, #{phone}, #{email})
mapper.update: UPDATE students SET student_no = #{studentNo}, name = #{name}, gender = #{gender}, birth_date = #{birthDate}, class_name = #{className}, phone = #{phone}, email = #{email}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
